about: What the server takes of each value the apps edit (design/src/values.ts; apps/server/src/day-values.ts, fitsField), so an app checks the same before it saves and a value it keeps stays once sent rather than going back on the next sync with the edits around it. Text is counted as spec/text-limits.md has it (text.json, fitsText and isEmoji); a pattern's own rule is patterns.json's fits. dayField: whether the server keeps `value` for a day's `field` (null clears it, which always fits): a pattern's id or "" (dayRules.noShift, a day cleared on purpose); a time as HH:MM, 00:00 to 23:59; a memo of up to textLimits.dayNote characters, spaces and all; people as 1 to syncLimits.peopleADay coworker ids separated by single spaces, each once, so a day takes no more people once it has peopleADay. coworkerName: a coworker's name, 1 to textLimits.personName characters, not only spaces. personName: a person's name as their profile or a group shows it, trimmed: up to textLimits.personName characters, empty being no name of their own. groupName: 1 to textLimits.groupName characters, not only spaces. groupMark: a group's mark, exactly one of one emoji, a mark icon's name (design/src/mark-icons.ts, never "letter", which only patterns draw), 1 to textLimits.groupMark letters, not only spaces, and a photo's id (1 to syncLimits.idLength characters, no spaces), with a `color` of the palette's 12 slots; a part left out is "" and the color 0. patternOrder: the patterns' order, `ids` separated by single spaces ("" for none): pattern ids, each once, and syncLimits.patterns at most, so a person who keeps that many adds no more. rotation: a repeating order's `sequence` of pattern ids separated by single spaces ("" for none, which ends repeating), each as often as it comes round: syncLimits.sequence at most. repeatOrders: the repeating orders of one timeline, each given by its rotation as `rotation` gives it: syncLimits.orders at most, each rotation fitting.
